subject: dymspt
title: DYM.SPT.------ALT.F.
description: Chart on book p. 51 (BK(NM)-27). DYMSPT (the title writes DYM.SPT.) is the subject; ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), INFO-DY and EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From PROG-CONT: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From INFO-DY: ALT-D (alternative definitions) and TM (terminology—or terms of a definition). From ALT-D: AF-COMP (affinity compression). From TM: AFI (affinity insight). From EXP-DY: WO-METH.
